# VibeRaven

> Production readiness for AI-built apps. Agent Context + Production Gate.

Canonical agent command:

```bash
npx -y viberaven --agent-mode
```

Install agent rules into this repo (or any repo):

```bash
npx -y viberaven init --agents all
npx -y viberaven doctor --agents
```

## Full canonical reference

- https://viberaven.dev/llms-full.txt

## Links

- https://viberaven.dev
- https://viberaven.dev/agent-context.md
- https://viberaven.dev/skills.json
- https://www.npmjs.com/package/viberaven

## Boundary

- A normal git push does not require a VibeRaven scan.
- Gate deploys and launch-readiness claims, not ordinary pushes.
